title: The core plugin becomes relay@amidman
what: The plugin now called core is called relay, and relay's marketplace is called amidman: the plugin ids become relay@amidman, delegate@amidman, front@amidman, observe@amidman, openspec@amidman, issues@amidman, product@amidman. The folder, the marketplace file, what relay setup writes, and every place that names the old ids change; relay setup's migrate moves existing settings (enabledPlugins keys and the extraKnownMarketplaces entry) from the old ids to the new ones, so no project silently loses the merge hook. Agent and skill names (delegate:worker) do not change.
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "Запланируй изменение в core plugin переименовать его в relay, мне не нравится название core", then "Действительно relay@relay звучит не очень, может тогда просто relay, в данном случае это не опция и он всегда будет включен", then picked "a" (plugin relay, marketplace renamed) with "Хорошо, давай relay@amidman". Facts, 26 Oct: 127 tracked files name plugins/core; ~/.claude/settings.json turns on core@relay, observe@relay, delegate@relay, front@relay and lists the marketplace relay under extraKnownMarketplaces (path /Users/amidman/relay); hook refusals end with "This hook comes from the core@relay plugin". Build alone, when no other branch is open, and after relay-s-repo-records-the-plugins-relay-developme (both change plugin settings). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
where: plugins/core/ the plugin folder, its hooks, lib and bin
.claude-plugin/marketplace.json the marketplace name and the plugin list
lib/relay_setup.py what setup writes into settings (enabledPlugins, extraKnownMarketplaces) and its migrate step

said: Разве мы не изменили marketplace на amidman, почему я вижу core@relay
Я ранее явно упонимал о переименовании core -> relay, после короткого обсуждения мы пришли к relay@amidman

question: Когда строить переименование в relay@amidman? Оно меняет 127 файлов, поэтому идёт одно, когда других открытых branch нет, и после пункта «relay's repo records the plugins relay development uses» (IP 90, 30 мин; оба меняют настройки plugins). Сейчас пункт стоит 69-м в очереди, IP 86.
options: a. Следующим: после merge train-22, ограничения gate и правила о конфликтах сначала тот пункт на 30 мин, затем переименование, новые полосы не запускаются до его merge (рекомендую).
b. В порядке очереди, по IP 86.
answer: a, как это изменение достигнет других проектов ? Я хочу чтобы оно было общим для всех проектов которые подключают relay
reading: 5 = a: build it next (after the open three, first the 30-minute plugins item), no new lanes until its merge. The owner wants the new ids to reach every project that connects relay.

fact: 28 Oct, measured: relay's plugins are turned on only in the user-level ~/.claude/settings.json (enabledPlugins core@relay, delegate@relay, front@relay, observe@relay and the marketplace relay under extraKnownMarketplaces), so every project on this Mac gets them from there; projects.toml registers only relay itself; no project's .claude/settings*.json names an @relay id. lib/relay_old_names.toml [plugin_key] already maps old ids to new ones (sdd@relay -> openspec@relay), and relay setup moves a project's settings by it. Front's decision (owner can reverse), from the owner's "Я хочу чтобы оно было общим для всех проектов которые подключают relay": the rename adds core@relay -> relay@amidman (and each X@relay -> X@amidman) to that map, and relay sync applies it to the user-level settings and to every project in projects.toml, so no project keeps the old ids and none silently loses the merge hook; relay doctor flags an old id left anywhere.
